technical_notes: Hosted trial: 7-day aggregated metrics attached — avg QPS during weekday peak: 12 QPS; 95th percentile burst: 58 QPS.
Concurrency observed (hosted trial, peak window): ~48 concurrent chat sessions; expected production concurrency target: 60 concurrent sessions.
Token mix (trial measured): 70% short requests (<=128 tokens total), 20% medium (~512 tokens total), 10% long (>1500 tokens total). Avg tokens per request: ~420 tokens.
Latency targets: p95 generation latency < 400ms for short requests; p95 < 800ms for medium. Business will tolerate up to 1s for long-form generation.
Desired dedicated baseline capacity: sustain 25-30 QPS steady, handle 60 QPS burst for regional peak; planning 2 reserved slots (24/7) with 2 additional burst nodes (on-demand).
Model & routing: primary model family = Llama-variant quantized for cost; fallback to lower-cost 7B variant during overload. Need policy control for per-route fallback.
Cache & batching ask: POC to validate prefix caching for common prompts (FAQ/KB) aiming for 25% token reduction on chat layer.
Cost sensitivity: target ~35% reduction in $/token vs hosted after switching to Dedicated + quantized runtime.
